name: Fi Tango Porto 2026
description: Feel the passion of Argentine tango as this international festival takes over the city. Watch world-class dancers perform in the stunning Palácio da Bolsa and even join a milonga yourself.
longDescription:
Fi Tango Porto 2026 is an international festival dedicated to Argentine tango, bringing together dancers, musicians, and enthusiasts from around the world. The event features a program of performances, workshops, and social dances known as milongas. It serves as a platform for the global tango community to gather in Porto, celebrating the art form and fostering connections among participants.

Attendees can observe professional tango dancers showcasing their skill and artistry in various performances. The festival also provides opportunities for participation, with milongas held at different locations, including the historic Palácio da Bolsa. The atmosphere is centered on the shared appreciation for tango, attracting both experienced dancers and those new to the genre. The Palácio da Bolsa provides a grand and historic setting for some of the festival's events.

Ticket prices for Fi Tango Porto 2026 vary depending on the specific events and packages chosen. Information regarding ticket purchase and detailed schedules will be available closer to the event date. The Palácio da Bolsa is located in the city center, within walking distance of São Bento train station and various metro and bus stops. Specific accessibility details for all venues are not provided.
